name: Ember Crown
description: Forged in obsidian. Molten seams breathe as sparks rise from the crown.

name: Moonlit Grove
description: Silver leaves, pearl dew and fireflies wandering through a moonlit garden.

name: Arcane Orbit
description: An amethyst astrolabe, alive with orbiting stars and a slow celestial current.

name: Deepwater
description: Sea glass catches the light. Tiny bubbles rise through luminous tidal currents.

name: Stormglass
description: Electric blue crystal charged with branching lightning along its dark metal edges.

name: Royal Gilt
description: Warm gold, ruby and laurel. A travelling gleam reveals every crafted edge.

name: Blossom Drift
description: Rosewood and spring blossoms, with delicate petals carried on a gentle breeze.

name: Astral Eclipse
description: A dark sun with a living corona. Violet stardust traces the edge of the eclipse.

name: The Uncrowned
requirement: Defeat the Uncrowned and complete Mora Mode.
description: A broken king’s crown, ribbed armour and a beating ruby heart.
animation: A double heartbeat sends red pulses up the ribs while the skull eyes kindle and cinders rise.

name: The Hollow Vow
requirement: Complete Mora Mode with all three Night pantry power-ups at rank zero when the run begins.
achievementName: An Empty Pantry, a Full Grave
description: Empty reliquaries, blackened thorns and the last embers of an unassisted victory.
animation: The four empty sockets contract and fade while ash drains into the hourglass.

name: Untouched Sovereign
requirement: Defeat the Uncrowned without losing any health or falling during the entire encounter.
achievementName: Not One Drop for the Crown
description: Unblemished gold and ivory surround a diamond heart. A flawless victory, made visible.
animation: An ivory faceted shield assembles around the rim, then breaks into outward diamond fragments.

name: Endless Sovereign
requirement: Defeat the Uncrowned twice in the same Endless Night run.
description: Twin crowned skulls guard an hourglass that never runs dry.
animation: Twin skulls breathe along opposing paths; the hourglass reverses its flow each cycle.

name: Home at Last
requirement: Return home, give Bernard his dish, finish the farewell and credits, and reach café free play.
description: The café lantern stays lit. Warm steam rises between coffee leaves and ivory blossoms.
animation: Three curling plumes rise from the coffee cup while the café lantern flickers.

name: Letters in the Fog
requirement: Resolve the final gathering and finish the two letter-delivery scenes; either supported delivery choice counts.
description: Sealed letters rest in silver branches as a quiet mist passes around the rim.
animation: Two sealed letters travel around the upper branches, opening their flaps through drifting fog.

name: The Living Conservatory
requirement: Complete the Nursery Seven inspection and its return debrief.
description: Glass terrariums, living ferns and tiny lights from Nursery Seven.
animation: Tendrils grow from the base, unfurl their leaves and restart at different times on each side.

name: Blooming Business
requirement: Earn 10,000 bronze in cumulative eligible business sales.
description: Copper, coffee and flowering branches mark a business that has truly taken root.
animation: Coins tumble edge-on down both sides while coffee beans bounce above the lower pouch.

name: Treble Sovereign
requirement: Win a top-flight league, its national cup and the Champions Crown with the same club in one season.
description: Three trophies, one season. Golden light travels around a champion’s laurel.
animation: Ivory and gold confetti descends as the three trophies celebrate in sequence.

name: Four Worlds
requirement: Win the top-flight league in all four worlds within one manager career.
description: Four world jewels illuminate in turn around an engraved celestial compass.
animation: A compass needle steps between four bearings, lighting the corresponding world jewel.

name: Academy Immortals
requirement: Win the Champions Crown final with all three starters being graduates of your own club's academy.
description: Three academy stars shine above oak and gold. Raised here, crowned everywhere.
animation: Laurel strokes climb from the base and the three academy stars illuminate one after another.

name: Crown Dynasty
requirement: Win the Champions Crown in consecutive seasons with the same club.
description: Consecutive crowns rest in navy velvet, with a restrained sweep of diamond light.
animation: Two navy ribbons ripple down the rim with gold edging that follows their movement.

name: Honeycomb Court
description: Amber honey and bronze combs catch the light as a tiny bee circles the edge.
animation: Honeycomb cells fill with amber while a bee flies a figure-eight over the crest.

name: Jade Serpent
description: A jade serpent coils through carved bronze, its scales lit by a travelling green gleam.
animation: A green wave runs through the carved scales and a forked tongue flicks from the serpent head.

name: Autumn Hearth
description: Copper leaves tumble past a welcoming amber lantern.
animation: Copper leaves tumble in wide descending arcs around a flickering hearth lantern.

name: Silver Thistle
description: Fine silver thorns and purple flowers hold flickering drops of moonlit dew.
animation: Thistle seeds with fine parachutes float away from the silver flowers.

name: Mothlight
description: An ivory moth rests above pearl vines, with tiny moths wandering along the rim.
animation: An ivory moth flutters along a slow upper arc, opening and closing all four wings.

name: Rose Reliquary
description: Burgundy roses, garnet facets and falling velvet petals.
animation: The top rose opens and settles while a single garnet dew drop slides down the rim.

name: Tidekeeper
description: Pearls and bronze rope follow a quiet tidal current.
animation: Four tidal wave bands lap against the lower ring, carrying flecks of pale foam.

name: Glasswing
description: Opalescent dragonfly wings scatter soft blue light.
animation: A dragonfly darts across the upper rim with four independently beating narrow wings.

name: Sunken Compass
description: An old bronze instrument wears sea glass and the patina of deep water.
animation: The compass needle sways underwater as expanding bubbles escape and pressure rings spread below.

name: Wildwood Stag
description: Carved walnut antlers shelter oak leaves and wandering forest light.
animation: Light branches up the stag’s antlers, then forks into their tips above the woodland rim.

name: Lavender Hour
description: Lavender and pewter surround an hourglass of gently falling light.
animation: Sand visibly drains from the top hourglass chamber into the lower chamber beside swaying lavender.

name: Copper Automaton
description: Warm clockwork ticks beneath engraved copper and brass.
animation: The top and side gears counter-rotate while a weighted pendulum swings below.

name: Ivory Sonata
description: Silver strings shimmer across ivory and walnut like a quiet melody.
animation: Silver strings vibrate and little musical notes rise along both sides.

name: Orchid Veil
description: Ivory orchids and mauve droplets float through a silver garden.
animation: The orchid petals gently open as mauve dew drops fall between the stems.

name: Crimson Oath
description: An old wax seal binds steel thorns and fine silver chain.
animation: Two crimson lines extend out from the wax seal, tracing the chain paths down both sides.

name: Amber Reliquary
description: Faceted amber keeps a soft golden pulse inside an antique bronze setting.
animation: A tiny insect stirs inside the top amber gem while slow air pockets rise through the resin.

name: Frost Fern
description: Fine frost drifts past silver fern fronds and pale blue crystal.
animation: Frost branches gradually grow around the fern rim and small ice fragments drop away.

name: Starlit Cartographer
description: An engraved brass astrolabe charts a slow procession of ivory stars.
animation: A constellation is charted point by point, joining stars with fine engraved-looking lines.

name: Phoenix Feather
description: Russet feathers and copper-gold tips release a few warm sparks.
animation: Two long copper feathers lift alternately up the sides with narrow warm trails.

name: Pearl Masquerade
description: Cream pearls and plum silk surround an elegant gilded mask.
animation: Plum silk ribbons ripple independently while the strung pearls gently sway.

name: The Verdant Cathedral
description: Layered gold architecture, glass and living vines; light moves through the canopy while fireflies rise.
animation: Stained-glass windows illuminate in staggered sequences and cast soft rays over opening ivy leaves.

name: The Celestial Orrery
description: Nested astronomical rings, pearl stars and a carefully timed procession of golden comets.
animation: Three tilted orbital rings turn at different speeds, carrying shaded planets and tiny ring systems.

name: The Gilded Leviathan
description: Twin sculpted sea dragons wear pearl scales, with travelling caustics and luminous currents.
animation: Twin streams pour from the dragons’ mouths, carrying foam down to colliding ripples beneath the shell.

name: The Winter Empress
description: Platinum filigree and faceted ice catch an aurora as delicate snow turns around the crown.
animation: Individual crown crystals grow and recede as six-armed snowflakes turn down both sides.

name: The Eternal Phoenix
description: Layered burnished wings surround a ruby heart, breathing warmth into rising golden feathers.
animation: The phoenix fans rows of golden feathers, its ruby heart breathes, and shed feathers rise along the wings.
